title: New Austin Mayor & Council Sworn In
summary:
*   Kirk Watson officially took office as Austin's new Mayor.
*   Three Council members—Gus Garcia, Bill Spelman, and Willie C. Lewis—were sworn in.
*   The Council re-elected Gus Garcia to serve as Mayor Pro Tem.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
JUNE 15,1997
1.
Swearing in ceremonies of the newly elected Mayor, Place 2, Place 5 and Place 6 of the
City
Council (Oath of Office)
Judge Orlinda Naranjo gave Oath of Office to Kirk Watson, Mayor; Gus Garcia, Place 2; Bill
Spelman, Place 5 and Willie C. Lewis, Place 6.
Mayor Watson called the meeting to order, Councilmember Griffith absent. 2.
Election of Mayor Pro Tern
Motion to re-elect Gus Garcia as Mayor Pro Tern on, Councilmember Goodman's motion,
Councilmember Lewis' second, 6-0 vote, Councilmember Griffith absent.
ADJOURNED at 5:30 p.m.
Approved on this the 26th day of June, 1997, on Mayor Pro Tern Garcia's motion,
Councilmember
Spelman's second, 7-0 vote.
